label: 6. I have a question for you, Commander.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: I have a question for you, Commander.
What's up?

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: What kind of cat do you like?
Cats that are black from head to toe.
Black cats with white paws.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Black cats are the best, aren't they?

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: So mystical and mysterious.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Every time I look at them, they evoke a special feeling within me,

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: they are truly adorable.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: I love them too.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: It looks like they're walking around with cute white socks on.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Who can possibly resist something that cute?
What about you? What's your favorite kind of cat?

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: That's a tough one.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Whether it's a solid or tuxedo coat,

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: both exude their own beauty and allure.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Then, you have some with distinct patterns resembling mini apex predators,

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: while others seem like fish that are ready to swim off at any moment.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: I find them all so appealing.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Don't forget, there are also ginger cats and calico cats...
In other words, you like all cats.
It's tough to choose just one, isn't it?

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: It is.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Long-haired cats are really cool,

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: but short-haired ones can also be really adorable.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Whenever I see them

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: basking in the sun with eyes gently shut,

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: I can practically feel myself loosening up and dozing off.
I know that feeling all too well.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: It's hard to choose just one.
I know, right? I can't do it either.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Talking with you about cats really makes my day.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: I can feel my fatigue melting away!

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Thank you, Commander.
I'm glad to talk with you at any time.
